responsibility: This file implements the generic lists container as a chunked linked list of fixed-size ADDRESS arrays. It supplies basic list services—append, nth-element lookup, first-match index search, counting, duplicate-aware insertion, deletion, iteration, and copying—and serves as mc’s general-purpose pointer list implementation separate from the specialized alists naming and Indexing’s direct-index storage.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the concrete implementation for the lists stem, defining the internal fixed-size-chunk list nodes and implementing insertion, lookup, removal, iteration, and duplication; the same-named .def file just exports the API.
